title: dev-next: runs on one computer test on the newest main and cap their test copies
summary: dev-next now merges origin/main before its gate, refuses to merge a branch behind main, and sizes test copies from physical cores, live runs and free memory with one recipe in in-flight.md; the starter CLAUDE.md gains a test-copies row. Version 23.
lessons_learned: On Windows Git Bash python3 is often the Microsoft Store alias; any shell recipe a skill ships must pick its interpreter the way tests/run.sh does
